correctness.rationale: For each outside vertex in part V_i, the selected-neighbor count is d-d_i. This identity proves both directions of the structural characterization. The polynomial follows by a unique common partial occupancy t for every proper fair set, with explicit corrections for the repeatedly counted full set and the empty set. Exhaustive verification through order 9 agrees with the literal definition for every subset.

value.rationale: The result solves a natural established enumerative problem for an entire classical graph family. It extends the known balanced biclique counting problem to arbitrary complete multipartite graphs, supplies a compact structural criterion and closed polynomial, and yields the exact minimum as a corollary. The claim is neither a finite census nor an arbitrary parameter slice.
